# Kogod School of Business at American University

> > Kogod School of Business delivers innovative business education in Washington, DC, with programs spanning sustainability management, business analytics & AI, global immersions, and dual degrees.

Located at American University in Washington, DC, Kogod offers undergraduate and graduate programs with distinctive focuses on sustainability, artificial intelligence, global business experiences, and interdisciplinary dual degrees. The school is home to research initiatives like the Sustainable Procurement Research Initiative and emphasizes real-world learning through global immersions and innovation challenges.

## Key Topics

- Sustainability Management
- Business Analytics & AI
- Sustainable Procurement Research Initiative
- Global Immersions
- Green Procurement
- MBA Programs
- Dual Degrees
- ESG and Corporate Sustainability
- Artificial Intelligence in Business
- Graduate Programs
- Undergraduate Business Education
- Study Abroad
- Innovation and Entrepreneurship
- International Business

## Academic Programs

- [The Kogod School of Business at American University Unveils AI Major, Minor, Badges, and Certificates](https://kogod.american.edu/news/the-kogod-school-of-business-at-american-university-unveils-ai-major-minor-badges-and-certificates): Kogod launches Business Analytics & AI major, minor, and certificates
- [Dual Degrees | Kogod School of Business](https://kogod.american.edu/programs-admissions/dual-degrees): Dual graduate degree programs combining MBA with law or international study
- [Kogod's New Core Curriculum Looks to the Future](https://kogod.american.edu/news/kogods-new-core-curriculum-looks-to-the-future): Casey Evans discusses Kogod's undergraduate curriculum reform initiative
- [MS in Sustainability Management Online Overview Webinar](https://kogod.american.edu/events/ms-in-sustainability-management-online-overview-webinar-06-06-2023): Webinar overview for MS in Sustainability Management online program

- [Advancing Green Purchasing in Slovak Municipalities](https://kogod.american.edu/news/advancing-green-purchasing-in-slovak-municipalities-1): Nicole Darnall's research on green procurement in Slovak municipalities
